title: Odd coefficient of a sign function
statement: For a function $f:\{\pm1\}\to\mathbb{R}$, define its odd coefficient to be $\bigl(f(1)-f(-1)\bigr)/2$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the two signs $\{\pm1\}$
